question: What totality is being indicated with respect to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: All earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs are referenced.
A totality of fields is referenced.
The two are linked in this compound construction.
inference: The whole group of fields belonging to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs is indicated.
uncertainties: The internal structure of that field-group is not specified.
plain_english: The whole group of fields of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
